relations.note: Clerics equated or coordinated Perchta with Diana as leader of nocturnal women.

relations.myth: Nocturnal ride with Diana and werewolves
relations.note: Perchta rides in a nocturnal company with Diana and werewolves.

relations.myth: Nocturnal ride with Diana and werewolves
relations.note: Perchta rides nocturnally in a company that includes werewolves.
Frau Percht and Frau Holt are listed separately among condemned supernatural figures.
Herodias and Perchta appear together in a clerical catalogue without narrative interaction.
Perchta is counted among three unnamed sisters who receive food offerings.
